description: The entire realm is constructed of literal words. A wooden sign labeled 'sign' points down a road made of the letters 'r-o-a-d'. Mountains labeled 'steep mountain' line the distance.

wall_text.description: Shifting block walls spelling out the word 'W-A-L-L'.

road_text.description: A flat dirt path formed by spelling 'R-O-A-D' repeatedly.

exit_south.description: The stone pass leading back south to the Mountains of Miserly.

exit_north.description: A steaming, fiery gate heading north toward a molten landscape.

dialogue.text: An apostrophe greets you, spelling out: "Welcome to Textlandia. We recommend you turn back. You are approaching creativity. Do not enter the typewriter, you will get lost."
You remark: "It doesn't look that large." Willy, Freddista, and the Apostrophe all shout in unison: "NO! NO! NO!!" You sigh: "Okay, no."

npc_sue_saul_cameo.description: Sue and Saul standing near a copy-pasted Hidden Hideout entrance.

dialogue.text: Sue and Saul greet you. Willy says: "We are heading toward creativity!" Upon hearing that, Sue and Saul both faint instantly from concern! Saul grunts from the floor: "*Faint... grrrr!*"
